warnings: This is a Zn fertilization study with 6 treatment rates (0, 2.3, 5.7, 11.4, 22.7, 34.1 kg ha-1), not CO2 study
Multiple Zn application rates - each rate vs zero control should be extracted separately
Data from two growing seasons (2013-2014 and 2014-2015) - may need separate extractions
Tables use Duncan's multiple comparison letters - extract raw means with variance
Primary outcome is grain Zn concentration, but many other Zn-related variables are reported
Root data only available for 2013-2014 season, shoot/grain data for both years
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: Values are average of four replications. For each cropping season, means in a column followed by same letters are not significant difference at P <0.05 by Duncan's multiple comparison test.
recon.control_definition: 0 kg ha-1 Zn application (no zinc fertilizer)
recon.treatment_definition: Zn fertilizer applied as ZnSO4·7H2O at rates of 2.3, 5.7, 11.4, 22.7, and 34.1 kg ha-1
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Multiple treatment rates could be confused - ensure each rate is compared to zero control
recon.sample_size_source: Each treatment was represented by four replicate plots, and the plots were arranged in a randomized block design
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration from Table 1 for both cropping seasons. Compare each Zn application rate (2.3, 5.7, 11.4, 22.7, 34.1 kg ha-1) against the 0 kg ha-1 control. Data shows n=4 replicates. Statistical analysis used Duncan's multiple comparison test. Extract raw means and calculate SE from the replicate information if needed.

table_descriptions.Table 1: Biomass, Zn concentration, Zn accumulation of grain and straw at maturity stage and Zn harvest index (ZnHI)
table_descriptions.Table 2: Biomass, Zn concentration, and Zn accumulation of shoot at anthesis stage
table_descriptions.Table 3: Root dry weight (RDW), root length density (RLD), and root surface area (RSA) at anthesis stage
table_descriptions.Table 4: Zinc concentrations and accumulations in root at anthesis stage and supply capacity of Zn (SCZn)
table_descriptions.Table 5: Pearson correlation coefficients among various Zn parameters
table_descriptions.Table 6: Zinc parameters during grain-filling period including remobilization data

recon.extraction_method_reason: Scanned/image tables - use vision to supplement text
challenge_hints: Verify all numbers carefully - OCR may confuse 0/O, 1/l/I
If numbers look wrong, flag for manual review
Check Methods section for 'mean ± SE' or 'mean ± SD' statement
Check table footnotes for variance definitions
